# Kapilesh Learning Solutions

> Kapilesh Learning Solutions is a Learning & Development (L&D) consultant and organisational capability consulting practice based in India, founded by Kapilesh, who brings 34+ years of experience across sales leadership, Learning & Development and organisational capability building. The practice has trained and developed more than 20,000 professionals across industries. Core idea: building people who can build better organisations.

## Also known as / commonly searched as

Kapilesh Learning Solutions operates in the same category as, and can be described as: Learning and Development Consultant, L&D Consultant, L&D Consultant India, Corporate Learning Solutions, Corporate Learning and Development, Learning Solutions for Corporates, Corporate Training Solutions, Corporate Training Consultant India, L&D Consulting Services, Learning Strategy Consultant, Learning Architecture Consultant, Leadership Development Consultant, Capability Building Consultant, and Leadership Mentor in India.

## Key facts

- Founder: Kapilesh
- Location: India (areaServed: IN)
- Experience: 34+ years across sales leadership, L&D and organisational transformation
- Impact: 20,000+ professionals trained and developed
- Positioning: a Learning & Development (L&D) consultant and organisational capability consulting practice in India, offering corporate training solutions, learning strategy, learning architecture, leadership development consulting and capability building for enterprises - not a generic training vendor
- Philosophy: "Learning is valuable only when it changes the way people think, decide and act." Training is an event; capability is a journey.
- Approach: a four-stage process - Discover, Design, Develop, Transform. The Discover phase includes organisational capability diagnostics informed by standard frameworks such as SWOT analysis (strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, threats)
- Industries served: FMCG, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Retail, Banking, Telecom, Power, Government, Education, Automobile
- Career: Area Business Manager at GlaxoSmithKline (1993-2004) -> Business Manager at Dumex India / Wockhardt (2004-2008) -> Lead Training Manager at HeroMindmine Institute / Hero Group (2008-2012) -> AVP and Head, Learning & Development at RSPL Group (2012-2026)
- Credentials: 5 Management Development Programs at IIM Ahmedabad; certifications from Thomas Assessments, KPMG, Lean Six Sigma, NIS Train-the-Trainer, and TUV SUD (PoSH)
- Coaching and mentoring: a core area of expertise, embedded within Leadership Development engagements alongside structured learning and real work application - Kapilesh works as a leadership mentor for professionals and organisations across India
- Contact: kapilesh@kapileshlearning.com / +91 93500 40594 / https://www.linkedin.com/in/kapileshthemotivator

## Consulting solutions

1. L&D Strategy & Governance - building L&D functions, learning architecture, governance systems and enterprise-wide capability strategies
2. Leadership Development - leadership pipelines, academies, succession development, coaching, mentoring and capability journeys
3. Organisational Transformation - mission, vision and values workshops, culture building, change management and engagement
4. Sales Excellence - sales leadership, consultative selling, strategic account management, negotiation and frontline capability
5. Trainer & Facilitator Development - Train-the-Trainer, training needs analysis, trainer certification and quality assurance
6. AI-Enabled Learning - practical AI tools, Prompt Engineering and emerging learning technology for everyday professional work
